answer: Charge every new agent a bonded entry fee paid in scarce compute vouchers that only mature after they deliver verified work across a meadow of peer tasks. Voucher minting burns nectar credits that cannot be recycled, so each clone burns fresh CAPEX. Reputation pigment is hashed into a public bond; if one identity is graded junk, linked clones lose their remaining vouchers. Attacker cost therefore scales linearly with swarm size rather than with free account spam.
